title: Gas-fired solution treatment of pipe fittings: five trial batches with the buyer’s parts
summary: After installation and commissioning, the agreement calls for five trial batches using the buyer’s stainless fittings. The buyer also supplies trays, lifting gear and blocks. Loaded acceptance checks the temperature curve, gas consumption and workpiece temperature variation.
seoTitle: Gas-fired solution furnace: who supplies the trial parts?
seoDescription: The 2011 document assigns trays, fixtures and trial fittings to the buyer. See empty and loaded commissioning and the five trial batches.

metrics: Trial batches required by the agreement
Minimum required maximum load per lift
forkReview.note: The 1-tonne furnace load excludes support blocks. The car rating assumes a uniformly distributed load including fixtures.
work: Furnace, fork car and electrical controls. The agreement calls the car a fork-handling mechanism.

forkReview.featuresTitle: Load conditions for the five trials
features: Weigh the furnace load and the transport load separately
Allow 1 tonne of fittings per furnace batch. For the car, weigh the fittings and accompanying fixtures together.
Check each batch’s fitting sizes, piece count, tray tare weight and arrival date.
Keep one record per trial batch
Record the temperature curve, gas consumption and soaking temperatures against each batch number.
forkReview.flowTitle: Installation, commissioning and five trial batches

stages.title: Prepare the fixtures
stages.note: The buyer prepares trays, lifting gear, support blocks and trial pieces.

stages.title: Empty commissioning
stages.note: After the factory inspection, install the equipment and run it empty at the buyer’s site.

stages.title: Loaded commissioning
stages.note: Check heat-up under load using the agreed workpieces and fixtures.

stages.title: Run five trial batches
stages.note: After empty and loaded commissioning, run five batches of the buyer’s fittings on site.

cards.title: Division of supply and load conditions
paragraphs: The furnace rating refers to the fittings. The car rating refers to fittings and fixtures together.
definitions: Furnace, fork car, furnace-side natural-gas piping and valves, combustion-air supply, exhaust ducting including an 18 m stack, combustion system, electrical controls and equipment documents.

head: Agreement item
Application to trial production
rows: 1 tonne per batch excluding support blocks. Prepare each batch of fittings to the agreed loading pattern.
Carrying capacity of the fork car
With a uniformly distributed load including fixtures, the maximum capacity per lift must be at least 2 tonnes. Weigh the fittings and fixtures together for transfer.
The buyer supplies the workpieces, raw materials and consumables. Confirm the size, count, tray tare and delivery time for each batch.

cards.title: What does loaded acceptance involve?
paragraphs: Start with factory inspection, then site installation, no-load commissioning and loaded heat-up. Fittings heat on a tray or in a basket and travel to the water with the fixtures. Acceptance requires five trial batches and compliance with the performance criteria: process curve, gas use, furnace uniformity during soaking and workpiece temperature variation.

figure.caption: Furnace and agreed equipment systems; complete the specified inspection and commissioning. Prepare trays, lifting gear, support blocks and trial fittings. Run empty, then under load, then process five trial batches on site. The specified charge is 1 tonne per batch.

related: Who provides the trays, fixtures and trial workpieces?
forkReview.faqIntro: Workpieces, fixtures and acceptance criteria for the five trial batches.
faq: Whose fittings are used after commissioning?
Use the buyer’s stainless fittings. The buyer also supplies trays, lifting gear, blocks, raw materials and consumables for the trial.
Along with the furnace and car, the supplier provides gas piping and valves, combustion air, exhaust ducting with an 18 m stack, combustion equipment, controls and equipment documents.
How many trials are required and what is checked?
Five trial batches of the buyer’s fittings. Check the process temperature curve, natural-gas consumption, furnace uniformity during soaking and temperature differences within the workpiece load.
